verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no automation objects that can be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back. The nearby items do not cover this story: Bionic auto-saving document edits, chat regeneration history, and REST API path versioning are different features. Since LM Studio offers agentic tasks and configuration management, the question applies to this kind of product, but nothing shows the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
